title: koanophyllon hondurensis
intro: Koanophyllon hondurensis, commonly known as Honduran treebine, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Koanophyllon hondurensis include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and potentially exerting antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant, although not extensively studied, are believed to include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
